why: Most Python environments hold several .pth files, and nearly all of them run code: virtualenv's, setuptools' distutils shim, an editable install's finder, a namespace package's long one-liner, pytest-cov's exec. Reporting any of them would put a review line on every Python developer's machine. A project's .venv is read even though the walk never enters it. And a .pth outside site-packages is not run by anything; PyTorch saves models with the extension, so it is not even read.
